newsitem.title: USA: PP&L Susquehanna unit in refueling outage.
newsitem.headline: PP&L Susquehanna unit in refueling outage.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power and Light Co said its operators shut down the Unit One reactor at the Susquehanna nuclear power plant Saturday to begin the unit's ninth refueling and maintenance outage.
The outage is expected to take about five weeks, and about 30 percent of the unit's uranium fuel will be replaced, the company said in a statement released over the weekend.
Among the projects to be done while the unit is shut down is an inspection of one of its three low-pressure turbines, the company said.
